releaseNotes:
☁️ Google Drive & Cloud Vault Fixes (v1.2.6) by Dhiraj:
• 🎨 Official Google Cloud & Google Drive Icons: Replaced generic emojis with official high-resolution vector logos.
• ⚡ Seamless Google Drive Backup: Fixed Storage Access Framework stream mode to support all cloud document providers.
• 📥 Smooth Restore Engine: Streamlined password entry with clear error feedback.
• 🛡️ In-App Security Certificate: 1-tap live verification of 0/68 Clean antivirus score.
• 🎁 Home Page 'Share with Friends' Banner: Invite friends with 1 tap right from the home screen.
• 💬 WhatsApp-Style Persistent Conversations: 1 chat box per person and per group.
